people.name: D. Scott Cooper

people.name: Chelsea
people.role: Reported scorer of generated anthem; surname unverified

cases.ai_component: GPT-4 response to a belonging question, plus performance directions. A generated choral anthem is also reported. Separate editorial and sermon sections are not labeled AI-written.
cases.human_intervention: Bossen supplied an expanded contextual prompt. Reading edits unspecified. Chelsea reportedly intervened to score the anthem.
cases.delivery_evidence: Author labels manuscript as preached; not independently checked against recording.
cases.artifact: Published prompt, generated reading/directions, human comparison reading, and sermon; no generation log or aligned recording inspected.
cases.validation_use: Useful for component segmentation and a disclosed generated-reading positive example. Human comparison shares topic, not identical contextual prompting.
cases.limit: Not evidence of AI sermon drafting, independent provenance, representative adoption, or causal effect.

cases.location: No church or delivery location established

people.name: Todd Brewer
people.role: Article author and prompt author; currently listed as Mockingbird managing editor, not a verified event pastor

cases.ai_component: ChatGPT Christmas-sermon example based on Luke with requested named-author quotations.
cases.human_intervention: Prompt specified subject and quotations; output editing not documented. Author discusses possible quotation inaccuracies.
cases.delivery_evidence: No actual preaching occasion, recipient congregation, or delivery established. Hypothetical Sunday-morning criticism does not prove delivery or non-delivery.
cases.artifact: Author-published prompt and generated example with commentary, not a generation log or service transcript.
cases.validation_use: Useful for disclosed generated-draft classification and prompt/output inspection.
cases.limit: Exclude from delivered-sermon exposure counts. No established U.S. worship event; publisher association is not congregation geography. Does not prove never delivered.

cases.location: Patchogue, Long Island, New York, United States

people.role: Unnamed musical director supplied prelude prompt

cases.ai_component: ChatGPT-assisted service including sermon, prayers and musical materials. Hymns are also described as suggestions, so do not label every musical item newly composed.
cases.human_intervention: Human prompts; replacement prayer prompted after breaking news; Wolter added spoken explanations. Exact sermon revisions unknown.
cases.delivery_evidence: UCC retrospective report, pastor quotations and sermon-presentation photo caption support event occurrence; no verbatim verification.
cases.artifact: News report only; no sermon manuscript, prompt log, or exact July 14 recording retrieved. Facebook link advertises July 21 follow-up, not an identified July 14 artifact.
cases.validation_use: Event-level disclosed-exposure record and service-component taxonomy.
cases.limit: Not text-level training/validation truth. Headline does not establish zero human contribution, generated scripture, or fully generated music.

people.name: Jay Cooper
people.role: Pastor of United Methodist congregation; service experiment organizer

cases.ai_component: UM News reports ChatGPT-generated worship service, including sermon and original song.
cases.human_intervention: Human organization established; prompts, model version, revision history and final sermon editing not established by inspected denominational report.
cases.delivery_evidence: Retrospective denominational report quoting pastor about completed service and congregational response; no independent recording review.
cases.artifact: Report links service video https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZxK8ruYZTvo ; ordinary landing-page fetch failed. No media, transcript or sermon text retrieved.
cases.validation_use: Event-level disclosure; specifically linked recording is a potential future delivery-validation source, not presently verified text.
cases.limit: No measured generated share or text alignment. Pastor descriptions of reception are reports, not controlled effects. Article’s AI interview transcription is journalistic processing, not sermon composition.
